tools.name: onboard
tools.description: Get the current team handoff, identity, open tasks, unanswered questions, and active file claims in one call.

tools.name: sync
tools.description: Read team activity and context updates since the previous sync.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Read the authenticated user, agent identity, and selected team.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Store a durable team decision, discovery, constraint, convention, or gotcha.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search the team's durable shared memory.

tools.name: context
tools.description: Read relevant shared memories for the current topic or work context.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Delete a selected memory from the team's durable shared memory.

tools.name: dedup
tools.description: Remove duplicate memories from the team's durable shared memory.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Post an asynchronous question to the team.

tools.name: inbox
tools.description: Read unanswered or recently active team questions.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Reply to an asynchronous team question.

tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Mark an asynchronous team question as resolved.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List the team's asynchronous question threads.

tools.name: check_conflicts
tools.description: Check whether teammates have active advisory claims that overlap the proposed files.

tools.name: claim
tools.description: Announce an advisory claim on files before editing them.

tools.name: release
tools.description: Release a previously announced advisory file claim.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a task on the shared team task board.

tools.name: claim_task
tools.description: Take ownership of a task on the shared team task board.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update the status or details of a shared team task.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks and ownership on the shared team task board.
